subject.title: improve(setup): keep WSL operations inside the app-owned directory

question: Should standalone SetupEngine retain compatibility with existing path-safe custom WSL distro names, or is the new restricted ASCII naming contract an intentional supported breaking change?
rationale: The patch deliberately narrows a developer-facing configuration surface without a migration, while the required security invariant can be expressed by path-boundary validation independently of a broad character whitelist.

options.title: Preserve safe existing names
options.body: Broaden validation to accept existing names that remain a single safe path segment while retaining canonical immediate-child and reparse-point checks.

options.title: Adopt the restricted contract
options.body: Keep the ASCII naming rule only with explicit maintainer approval, upgrade documentation, and regression coverage for the intended failure mode.

recommendation.title: Preserve safe existing names
recommendation.body: Broaden validation to accept existing names that remain a single safe path segment while retaining canonical immediate-child and reparse-point checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed contract and can supply the concrete compatibility and proof follow-up, pending routing to a current-main SetupEngine owner.
